text_block_list.text:
Invited by Mejiro McQueen,
I came to the Mejiro family's tea party today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you, Trainer!
—Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even though I told you casual wear would be fine...
Doesn't wearing a suit feel rather suffocating?
choice_data_list: No, this is a prestigious Mejiro tea party, after all...!
No, it's a prestigious Mejiro tea party, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... So they are quite nervous, then.
In other words, this is my time to shine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please remain by my side.
And so, the tea party began, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now next, scoop up the jam and clotted cream with the knife... and onto the scone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The jam and cream are so sparkly.
It looks delectable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!
N-Now, please put it in your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, hurry.
Otherwise, my stomach won't be able to hold out much longer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I still have an important duty ahead.
I must keep my mouth open and ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Lady Mejiro McQueen and company.
May I offer my greetings?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, it has been a while.
Please, allow me to introduce my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, shake hands as you state your name.
As a matter of etiquette, no bowing.

With Mejiro McQueen covering for me,
I managed to exchange greetings properly according to etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
We managed to get through the greetings somehow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No. Please, leave everything here to me.
After all, you and I are partners.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san?
You've gone quiet, is something wrong?
choice_data_list: I just thought it looked really cool.
I thought I need to work hard to be worthy of standing beside you

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I do.
I am a Mejiro, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still... "cool", huh.
Trainer thinking of me like that... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then I must give it my all and show you my cool side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Umm... no need to worry, I guess?
Or rather, maybe I'm intruding...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: R-Ryan!? How long have you been standing there...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Looking cool in front of your partner, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha~.
Just watching you makes me blush! So hot, hot, hot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it all wrong?!
I wasn't being narcissistic or anything just now!
I just got caught up in the moment, um...!
Afterward, they continued to enjoy the tea party while being coolly(?) supported by Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though you say you're plenty satisfied as is...
...Still, that's just like my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then, I must live up to that spirit as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From how to drink tea to greeting etiquette,
I shall instruct you in all manner of things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Today, I am the Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen's in high spirits.
Looks like I had nothing to worry about after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan!
Yes, I'm providing her with proper support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, impressive, impressive♪
Then why not chat with me for a bit too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh my. If that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let us begin our special training right away!
After that, they continued to enjoy the tea party while being taught proper etiquette by Mejiro McQueen.
